policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Belize visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens do not need a visa to enter Belize.
conditions: The guidance describes visits up to one month and requires a passport valid for at least six months. Extensions, work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: British Virgin Islands visa-free visits
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens do not need a visa for the British Virgin Islands.
conditions: Complete the BVI entry declaration before arrival and pay the stated environmental and tourism levy at the port. Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Iran electronic visa
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens can obtain an electronic visa and that airport visa issuance is suspended.
conditions: Apply through Iran's Foreign Ministry electronic-visa service before travel. Airport visa issuance is suspended until further notice; work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Iran Foreign Ministry eVisa
steps: Submit the electronic visa application through Iran's Foreign Ministry before travel.
Track the application through the same official service.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Mali advance visa
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens need a visa and may apply at Mali's embassy in Berlin.
conditions: Apply at the named embassy before travel. Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Niger advance visa
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens need a visa and may apply at Niger's embassy in Brussels.
conditions: Apply at the named embassy before travel. Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: South Sudan advance visa
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance requires Slovenian citizens to apply personally at South Sudan's embassy in Brussels.
conditions: Apply in person at the named embassy before travel. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovenian ordinary passports: Syria electronic visa
policies.summary: Slovenian MFA guidance says Slovenian citizens need a visa and may arrange it through Syria's eVisa service.
conditions: Apply through the linked Syrian eVisa service before travel. The Foreign Ministry advises against all travel; safety, work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Syria official eVisa
steps: Arrange the visa through the linked electronic service before travel.
